newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Italy bid for weak lira against mark in ERM.
newsitem.headline: Italy bid for weak lira against mark in ERM.

text.p: Italy tried to join the exchange rate mechanism at 1,010 lira to the mark earlier on Saturday but the majority of its EU partners wanted it below 1,000, a monetary offical told Reuters.
"It all depends on the Italian position. It demanded a central parity that its partners had difficulties accepting," the official said.
"The majority wanted a parity below 1,000," the source said.
The proposals were made at a meeting of the EU's monetary committee called to allow Italy to rejoin the exchange rate mechanism after a four year absence.
The committee has so far failed to agree a rate and broke up for an hour at 1930 GMT.
If no agreement is reached on Saturday, EU finance ministers were on stand-by to meet in Brussels on Sunday to find a solution.
